data.summary: The reviews present a concerning story. The Google profile appears potentially curated with a few recent, generic 5-star reviews. The Yelp rating of 3.1 with 34 reviews is more credible and suggests significant customer dissatisfaction. The single detailed 1-star Google review alleges a serious breach of contract: taking a $4,000 deposit in August 2023 and failing to perform the work or communicate by February 2024. The lack of BBB profile and other platform reviews limits context, but the core complaint pattern is severe and specific.
fake_signals: Google reviews are very recent (9-11 months)
Google reviews are generic and lack detail
No reviews on Google HQ profile
Possible review solicitation on low-volume Google profile

negative_evidence: Paid $4,000 upfront for equipment replacement that was never completed

authentic_signals: Specific complaint with details (name, date, amount, project)
Varied platform presence indicates real business
Yelp has substantial review count suggesting organic feedback
data.discrepancy_explanation: Significant rating gap between Google (4.2) and Yelp (3.1). Google has only 5 reviews, all recent, while Yelp has 34 reviews with a lower average, suggesting a more established and mixed reputation.

reviews.text: I had been using Parting Waters periodically for years. They had always been very knowledgeable and professional. I would recommend using them if you are ever in need.
reviews.author: Mike Clark

reviews.text:
I started using Parting Waters Pool Cleaning (Rod Brown) last year.  Things seem to go fine at first.  I contracted with him to replace pool equipment in August of 2023 and paid him $4,000 up front.
It is now February 2024 and my pool equipment has still not been replaced and he no longer answers my phone calls or responds to my tests  . I will be taking him/them to court it seems.
reviews.author: R. Scott Dobbs
